summary: TelegramSender additions are clean thin wrappers + a correctly-isolated album array-mapper. The shared retry/429/audit/scrub seam is reused via a generic sendMapped() whose only per-call deltas are the response mapper and the success-metadata builder, so the failure matrix stays byte-identical across single-message and album sends. No resource duplication, no architectural drift. Existing send/sendText/sendPhoto/mapBodyToSentMessage signatures unchanged.

findings.finding: Initial implementation used fully-qualified java.util.* and java.util.function.* names inline instead of top-of-file imports, inconsistent with the rest of the file.
findings.note: Added java.util.List/ArrayList/function.BiFunction/Function imports and replaced the fully-qualified references.
